ossumancer.name: The Gravekeeper
ossumancer.say: The Gravekeeper, lantern low, counting his dead. He will lend you the ones he cannot fit in the ground.
ossumancer.txt: +1 to Ossuary skills · +4 armor · -1% faster movement

ossumancer.name: The Marrow-Eater
ossumancer.say: The Marrow-Eater cracks the bones to suck out what is inside. Hungry god. Hungry child.

ossumancer.name: The Ossuary Wall
ossumancer.say: The Wall. Bone on bone on bone. Behind it you will be safe. Nothing behind it is ever safe.
ossumancer.txt: +1 to Carapace skills · +2 Constitution · -1% faster cast rate

hemomancer.name: The Brood-Bride
hemomancer.say: The Brood-Bride. Every tumour is a child to her. You will make a very good mother.
hemomancer.txt: +1 to Brood skills · +1% life · -1% skill damage

hemomancer.name: The Open Vein
hemomancer.say: The Open Vein. She never closed. She never will. Neither will you.
hemomancer.txt: +1 to Blood skills · +1% skill damage · -1% life

hemomancer.name: The Butcher
hemomancer.say: The Butcher, apron stiff with it. She taught the golem how to stand. She will teach you how to carve.
hemomancer.txt: +1 to Flesh skills · +2 Constitution · -1% magic resist

animancer.name: The Soul-Smith
animancer.say: The Soul-Smith hammers breath into iron. The iron screams, and then it obeys. Everything obeys, in the end.
animancer.txt: +1 to Mirror skills · +4 armor · -1% faster cast rate

animancer.name: The Lantern-Bearer
animancer.say: The Lantern-Bearer. The wisps come to her like sparks to a draught. They will come to you. Pray they are only sparks.
animancer.txt: +1 to Soul skills · +1% faster refill · -3 armor

animancer.name: The Speaker
animancer.say: The Speaker. Her words unmade a city. Yours will unmake smaller things. Begin with yourself.
animancer.txt: +1 to Thread skills · +1% faster cast rate · -1% life

miasmancer.name: The Purifier
miasmancer.say: The Purifier. She draws the defilement out of the dead and binds it in paper. Breathe in what the world cannot bear, little assassin.
miasmancer.txt: +1 to Miasma skills · +1% magic resist · -1% life

miasmancer.name: The Keeper at the Gate
miasmancer.say: The Keeper at the Gate, who guards the spirit road. It is never where you look. Neither will you be.
miasmancer.txt: +1 to Distortion skills · +1% faster movement · -3 armor

miasmancer.name: The Bell-Rope
miasmancer.say: The Bell-Rope, pulled to wake the spirits before a killing. One pull for every ending. It will be pulled once for you.
miasmancer.txt: +1 to Death skills · +1 life after each kill · -1% magic resist

monk.name: The Laughing Face
monk.say: The Laughing Face. It laughs at the sun for thinking it could clean anything. Laugh with it, and burn.
monk.txt: +1 to Radiance skills · +1% skill damage · -1% magic resist

monk.name: The Empty Bowl
monk.say: The Empty Bowl. Everything poured into it is gone. Beg with it, little monk. The world will fill it for you.
monk.txt: +1 to Absence skills · +1 life after each kill · -1% life

monk.name: The Unmoved
monk.say: The Unmoved. A mountain does not hate the valley. It simply falls on it.
monk.txt: +1 to Destroyer skills · +2 Constitution · -1% faster movement

ossumancer.name: Oss-Vharoth
ossumancer.say: Oss-Vharoth. The Standing Dead, the skeleton that would not lie down when the god fell. It held your cradle the way a grave holds a coffin. You will stand. You will not bend. You will break.

hemomancer.name: Nol-Shogthuth
hemomancer.say: Nol-Shogthuth, the flesh that keeps growing with no mind to stop it. The Wheel turns in her and she drinks what spills. She was ascendant, and she was thirsty. You will live long enough to regret it.

animancer.name: Yh'Anuul
animancer.say: Yh'Anuul. The Veiled Crone, the god's soul, still at her loom though no hand works it. She drew one thread out of your cradle and held it up to the light. She has not put it down. Little thread. Little thread.

miasmancer.name: The Myriad
miasmancer.say: The Myriad. Not one god: every stone and river and rotting thing in this corpse-world has a small spirit of its own, and they are choking on the filth. Your people bow to all of them. You will draw the rot out of the world, hold it in yourself, and give it back to what made it.

monk.name: Ur-Nihl
monk.say: Ur-Nihl. ... No. I will not look into the bowl for that one. See: the blood has gone still. Smooth as black glass. It is not a god that looked down on you. It is the hole the gods are lying in, and it was smiling.

cards.name: The Gravedigger's Hands
cards.say: You have buried more than you remember. Your hands have not forgotten.

rev.say: Reversed, the hands dig their own grave. They are very good at it.

cards.name: The Singed Veil
cards.say: Drawn to every light that burns you. You will find pretty things in the ash.

rev.say: The veil upside down: it has already burned. It moves quicker for it.

cards.name: The Swaddling
cards.say: Soft. Warm. It will not last, but it will bleed a long while.

rev.say: The swaddling reversed is the knife. Softness was never going to last.

cards.name: The Gleaner
cards.say: You will pick at what the others leave behind. So do I.

rev.say: The gleaner turned over picks at better things than coin.

cards.name: The Weeping Saint
cards.say: She wept for all of you. None of you wept for her.

rev.say: The saint reversed stops weeping and starts to endure.

cards.name: The Scholar's Eye
cards.say: You will read the world closely. The world does not like being read.

rev.say: The eye turned inward learns faster, and sees less.

cards.name: The Hanged Twin
cards.say: One of you hangs. The other runs. You know which one you are.

rev.say: Reversed, it is the hanged one you become. Heavier. Harder to kill.

cards.name: The Knot of Mouths
cards.say: Many mouths, one hunger. You will eat well at every grave.

rev.say: The knot reversed hoards instead of eats.

cards.name: The Wick
cards.say: You burn quickly. Everyone who burns quickly thinks it is a gift.

rev.say: The wick upside down burns slow. You will last. You will be slow about it.

cards.name: The Pilgrim
cards.say: A long road, and nothing at the end of it. You will walk it anyway.

rev.say: The pilgrim reversed runs from the road instead of walking it.

cards.name: The Mourner
cards.say: Grief has made you hard to wound. It has made you hard to love, too.

rev.say: Grief reversed is rage. It will feed your spells and leave you open.

cards.name: The Ossuary Key
cards.say: It opens every door in the house of bones. Only one of them lets you out.

rev.say: The key turned opens the other doors, the ones with treasure behind them.

cards.name: The Beggar's Cup
cards.say: Empty, always empty. You will fill it with the lives of others.

rev.say: The cup reversed spills gold. You will be rich and learn nothing.

cards.name: The Drowned Bell
cards.say: It still rings under the fen. Everyone who hears it goes a little slower, a little safer.

rev.say: The bell reversed rings upward, out of the water. You will hurry toward the surface all your life.

cards.name: The First Coin
cards.say: The first thing you ever sold. It fit in your palm. You have been finding smaller things to sell ever since.

rev.say: The coin kept, never spent. It rings when you strike. Things flinch from it.

cards.name: The Kiln
cards.say: What goes in soft comes out hard, or does not come out.

rev.say: The kiln gone cold. Whatever was inside hardened slowly. It will not crack.

cards.name: The Unravelling Loom
cards.say: Someone is weaving you and someone is pulling the thread out, and they are working at the same speed.

rev.say: The loom turned over weaves tighter. Slower, but it holds together under blows.

fears.name: The dark
fears.say: The dark. Good. It is the one thing down there that will never lie to you.

fears.name: Burning
fears.say: Fire. Everything you love will burn, so you have that to look forward to.

fears.name: Drowning
fears.say: Drowning. You will hold your breath a long time. Longer than the others. Not long enough.

fears.name: Being surrounded
fears.say: So many hands. You will learn to wear something thick. It will not be enough.

fears.name: Being forgotten
fears.say: Forgotten. Then go and do something worth remembering. Quickly.

fears.name: Being hunted
fears.say: Hunted. You can hear it already, can you not? Run.

fears.name: Your own face
fears.say: Your own face. Wise. I have seen it. I would not look either.

fears.name: Starving
fears.say: Hunger. The dead are full of meat. You will learn not to mind.

fears.name: Bells
fears.say: Bells. Yes. There is one in the ash that walks. You will know it by its ringing. Run sideways.

fears.name: Hands in the dark
fears.say: Hands. They run on their fingers out there. Keep your back to a wall and they cannot come around you.

fears.name: Silence
fears.say: Silence. Then you fear the right thing. The only thing. Most never learn to.

seeks.name: Vengeance
seeks.say: Vengeance. That door is heavy, and it only opens one way.

seeks.name: Knowledge
seeks.say: Knowledge. There is a library beneath the Crypt. Its books read you back.

seeks.name: Wealth
seeks.say: Gold. Of course. The dead do not need it, and they will not stop you. Mostly.

seeks.name: Absolution
seeks.say: Absolution. From whom? Every god you could ask is dead or hungry.

seeks.name: Oblivion
seeks.say: Oblivion. That door is always open. You need not hurry.

seeks.name: Power
seeks.say: Power. They all say power. They all looked like you when they said it.

seeks.name: A way home
seeks.say: A way home. There is no home. There is a road, and it is long, and it goes down.

seeks.name: The dead god
seeks.say: The dead god itself. Its heart is down there somewhere, under all of us. You would not be the first to go looking. You would not be the last to be eaten.

seeks.name: A god who answers
seeks.say: A god who answers. Oh, they answer. That is the whole trouble with them.

seeks.name: Your kin
seeks.say: Your kin. The Tithed scatter like seed. Some of them took root in very strange places.

seeks.name: The end of all of it
seeks.say: The end. You would hand the world to the Void? Then you had better be strong enough to carry it there.

roads.name: The Pilgrim Road
roads.say: The pilgrim road. Worn hollow by knees. Everyone on it was walking to a god who had already died.

roads.name: The Black River
roads.say: The river. It runs under the barrows and comes up cold. You still smell of it.

roads.name: The Ash Road
roads.say: The ash road. Something burned at both ends of it. You walked through the middle.

roads.name: The Ossuary Stair
roads.say: The stair of bones. Every step was someone. You counted them, at first.

roads.name: The Red Ditch
roads.say: The red ditch. It was a road once. Then the war came, and then the war stayed.
roads.txt: +1 life after each kill · -1% magic resist

roads.name: The Lampless Way
roads.say: No lamps on that way. You found it by touch. Your hands remember things your eyes never saw.

roads.name: The Bell Road
roads.say: The bell road. They ring for the dead up there, day and night. You learned to speak between the strokes.

roads.name: No Road at All
roads.say: No road. You simply were here, one evening, by my fire. That happens more than you would think. It is never good.

sacs.name: Your name
sacs.say: Your name, then. No one will speak it over your grave. There will be no one to speak.

sacs.name: Your shadow
sacs.say: Your shadow. Light as smoke without it. Thin as smoke, too.

sacs.name: Your left eye
sacs.say: The left eye. It saw too much kindness anyway. Now you will see only what you strike.

sacs.name: Your warmth
sacs.say: Cold, then. The cold keeps. The cold keeps everything.

sacs.name: Your mother's face
sacs.say: Her face. Already gone. You will wonder, some nights, whose voice that was.

sacs.name: Your sleep
sacs.say: No more sleep. No more dreams. You will not miss the dreams. Trust me.

sacs.name: Your voice
sacs.say: Your voice. You will scream silently now, like the rest of us.

sacs.name: Your luck
sacs.say: Luck. Ha! You never had much. I will take what there is.

sacs.name: Your hunger
sacs.say: Hunger. Strange gift to give. The dead will feed you instead.
sacs.txt: +1 life after each kill · -1% gold found

sacs.name: Your sense of taste
sacs.say: Taste. You will eat ash and marrow and not mind it. Good. That is most of what there is.

sacs.name: The last song you knew
sacs.say: The song. I will hum it sometimes. You will not recognise it.

sacs.name: Your fear of heights
sacs.say: You will not fear falling. You will fall a great deal, and you will get up faster for it.

q: When you woke in the ash, something was in your hand.

a.name: A stone
a.say: A stone. You held on to the world before you knew what it was. It will hold on to you.

a.name: Nothing
a.say: Nothing. Empty hands run faster. They catch less, too.

a.name: Another hand
a.say: Another hand. Cold? It was cold. You have been holding the dead ever since.
a.txt: +1 life after each kill · -1% gold found

q: There is a voice in the Drowned Fen that speaks to travellers.
When you passed, what did it say?

a.name: My name
a.say: Your name. So it knows you. Learn quickly, before it learns the rest.

a.name: Nothing I understood
a.say: Nothing you understood. A mercy. Understanding is how it gets in.

a.name: Your name
a.say: My name? ...Then it is looking for me through you. Find it pretty things, little messenger.

q: Everyone here was buried once. The god made sure of that.

a.name: My mother
a.say: Your mother. She buried you gently. You will be hard to kill because of it.

a.name: A stranger
a.say: A stranger, who took your boots for the trouble. You will learn to take boots too.

a.name: No one. I dug myself out
a.say: You dug yourself out. Your hands remember the dirt. Your spirit remembers less.

q: Suppose you find it. The dead god. Whatever is left of its heart.

a.name: Bury it
a.say: Bury a world. It would take a very long time. You have that, perhaps.

a.name: Eat it
a.say: Eat it! Ha. Many have tried. The god is patient with its eaters. It becomes them.
a.txt: +1 life after each kill · -1% magic resist

a.name: Wake it
a.say: Wake it. Then the Void comes for you first. Remember I warned you.

q: The lanterns call you back each time you fall.
Why do you think they want you?

a.name: Because they are kind
a.say: Kind. Yes. Hold on to that one. Hold on hard.

a.name: Because I am useful
a.say: Useful. A tool that knows it is a tool. That is almost a person.

a.name: Because they are hungry
a.say: Hungry. Now you are thinking like one of us.

prophecies: You will die in the dark, and it will not be the last time.
A crown of bone is waiting for a head. It is not particular about whose.
Something below the Crypt has learned your name. Try not to answer it.
The lanterns will keep calling you back. Ask yourself why they want you so badly.
Three faces will want you. None of them will want you whole.

fear: You flinched. Where the Tithed walk, flinching keeps you alive. Fools call it cowardice.
I will not laugh at what you fear. I fear things too. Worse things.
seek: Some go down for gold, some for gods. The god does not care why. It eats both.
You want something. It is written all over you, in a hand I do not like.
sac: We are nearly done. This is the part that hurts.
Do not look away from the knife. It is rude.
